title: Inhomogeneous $q$-Whittaker polynomials II: ring theorem and positive specializations
summary: We study inhomogeneous $q$-Whittaker polynomials which extend both $q$-Whittaker and stable Grothendieck polynomials. We prove that inhomogeneous $q$-Whittaker polynomials (in countably many variables) form a basis of certain commutative ring extending the ring of symmetric functions to a subring of its completion. We then describe positive specializations of that ring and relate them with a subset of Macdonald-positive specializations of the ring of symmetric functions.
